results.releaseNotes:
Protego 3.5.3 colors your comment threads and adds a batch of smaller comforts across the app.

Long conversations are hard to follow when every reply line looks the same. Thread Colors gives each reply depth its own color, on new and old Reddit alike, with four themes to choose from. Old Reddit fans can have image posts expand on their own while they scroll, and short keywords like AI can finally be filters.

No account, no tracking, and your lists stay in your own iCloud.

WHAT'S NEW:
- Thread Colors: give each comment reply depth its own color, so you always know which reply belongs where. Four themes: Default, Rainbow, wobniaR, and Vibecoded, each previewed with its palette before you choose. Works on new and old Reddit; find it in Transform, under Comment Threads.
- Auto-expand images: old Reddit image and gallery posts open inline as you scroll, exactly as if you had tapped each expand button. A post you collapse stays collapsed. Find it in Transform, under Feed and Layout.
- Two-letter keywords: AI, VR, and other short terms can now be filters. A short keyword with a wildcard, like ai*, also matches longer words, so Protego states the trade-off and asks before adding it.
- Crosspost button: a new switch hides Reddit's crosspost control on posts, on both Reddit designs.
- Achievement updates: a new switch stops the achievement pill that slides in after you share or comment. Unlike Reddit's own setting, it applies across your devices and survives clearing website data.

IMPROVEMENTS:
- Keyword groups can be selected right in the list's Select mode: bulk-delete a mixed selection and choose whether the group's keywords go with it, or ungroup with a swipe.
- Updating Protego no longer moves you off your chosen preset when an update adds new settings to it.

FIXES:
- Hiding post thumbnails also hid a card-view post's own photo or video on new Reddit: your media stays visible now, and only the link thumbnail goes.
results.description:
Add a keyword, a community, a user, or a domain, and matching posts quietly disappear from your feed. Protego is a Safari extension with a companion app, on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Vision Pro.

WHY THE BROWSER:
Reddit belongs in your browser. The official app is built to keep you scrolling; in Safari, you decide what Reddit shows you, and Protego does the filtering. No notifications pulling you back, no "get the app" walls, and no Reddit app on your phone collecting in the background.

FILTER WHAT YOU CHOOSE:
- Keywords - Hide posts whose title, body, or community name matches a word or phrase
- Communities - Hide everything from a community, or block its page entirely
- Users - Hide one person's posts and comments
- Domains - Hide posts linking to a particular site
- Social Media - Hide posts linking to X, Instagram, TikTok, and more
Keywords go further: * matches a word and its variations, # matches any 1 to 3 digit number, and groups switch a whole set on or off at once. Any filter can be switched off without deleting it.

SET UP IN ONE TAP:
Pick a preset (Off, Minimal, Balanced, or Focused) and Protego applies a recommended set of options, stripping out distractions to bring new Reddit closer to the old one. Fine-tune anything afterward.

CLEAR AWAY THE CLUTTER:
- Hide thumbnails, avatars, flair, badges, vote controls, award and join buttons, and community banners
- Hide recommendations, promoted posts, login and app nudges, and Reddit Answers
- Collapse or hide comments carrying media, and the moderator comment pinned to the top of a thread
- Color-code comment threads by reply depth, with four themes to pick from
- Bring back who posted on the home, popular, and news feeds
- Skip Reddit's For You home test and return to Following (experimental)
- Land on old Reddit automatically, with an endless feed

PUT REDDIT OUT OF REACH:
Filtering hides what you do not want to see. Limits goes further and blocks Reddit itself, a step at a time: Home and Popular first, then all main feeds, then everything but direct links to posts, then all of Reddit. Pair a limit with a Focus like Sleep or Study and it turns itself on.

PRIVACY:
No account, no tracking, no browsing history collected. Your filter lists stay on your devices and in your own iCloud.

YOURS ON EVERY DEVICE:
- One purchase covers iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Vision Pro
- No subscription, and optional tips are the only in-app purchase. Nothing is locked behind them
- Lists sync over your own iCloud, even with the app closed
- Works on new and old Reddit
- English, Spanish, and Brazilian Portuguese
- Import and export your lists
- Stats showing how much Protego has filtered, with a shareable card

Protego filters text: post titles, bodies, community and author names, and link addresses. It cannot read words inside images or videos. Filtered posts are hidden from your view. Nothing is removed from Reddit, and nobody is notified.
